content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, Section 7.7 / p0032).**

- **Issue:** Section 7.7 requires *us* to pay Brightline "as liquidated damages and not as a penalty" 15% of annual Fees **for each week** an invoice is unpaid, triggered after only ten days. Uncapped and compounding, it would quickly exceed the remaining contract value — walk-away territory, and well beyond the fallback (early-termination fee capped at 3 months' Fees).
- **Rest of document is clean:** Section 9.4 allows termination without cause with only accrued Fees owed; Section 27 termination is "without penalty"; there is no SLA credit or shortfall construct running against us.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** replaced the liquidated-damages mechanic with simple interest at the lesser of 1% per month or the legal maximum on *undisputed* invoices unpaid 30 days after due date, plus an express statement that we owe no liquidated damages or penalties — consistent with our Section 7.3 right to withhold genuinely disputed amounts.
